codeReview.summary: The pagination UI mostly matches the requested controls, but the implementation hides the entire pagination bar whenever the current page has zero rows. That breaks the required page number display and boundary-aware navigation for empty result sets beyond the last page or after underlying data shrinks, leaving operators stranded on an empty page with no way to navigate back from the UI.

issues.description: The pagination bar is gated by `hasResults`, so it disappears whenever `attempts.length === 0`. If the URL points to an out-of-range page (for example after filters narrow results or total rows drop), the page shows the empty state with no page number, no disabled/enabled Prev/Next controls, and no page-size selector. This violates VAL-DL-013's requirement to show current page/pagination controls with URL-synced state and prevents recovery from an empty later page without manually editing the URL.

summary: Reviewed commit `91d26026` plus the worker transcript skeleton and handoff. The feature does not fully satisfy VAL-DL-013 because pagination controls vanish on empty pages, which strands URL-synced out-of-range states. I also noted a skill-process gap (no RED test/lint despite required procedure) and missing shared knowledge for deterministic Email Delivery manual verification.
